title: Got Arrested From The Bathroom Then Ran From Jail
description:
Note for the privacy complaint reviewer: No personally identifying information is a part of the video. This is a newsworthy piece of content. The homeowner allowed the police officers to enter the house.

Start a completely FREE trial with our sponsor Aura and protect yourself from getting scammed: https://www.aura.com/insider 

On April 14th, 2022, officers responded to a domestic disturbance call where a man was breaking down the door of the residence and actively fighting his brother. After reaching the jail entrance, while jail staff were asking him some medical questions, Ryan took off running and ran out through one of the doors. An officer ran after him and gave him commands to stop, but he wouldn't comply. Eventually officers were able to catch up to him and tackled him to the ground. Ryan was charged with Battery Upon A Peace Officer, Escaping From Custody, Resisting Law enforcement and Battery.
